## Catalog checks

- [ ] Updated JSON sources and regenerated the English catalog and benchmark index.
- [ ] Merged related paper, blog, code and data links where appropriate.
- [ ] Verified authors and paper-time affiliations against primary sources.
- [ ] For papers, recorded downloaded full text and consulted body/technical sections with page references.
- [ ] Distinguished author-released HF models/adapters from datasets, collections and cited base models.
- [ ] Kept medium, publication status and reproduction evidence distinct.
- [ ] For an environment, separated feedback origin, interaction and new physical execution.
- [ ] Ran `python scripts/validate.py` and `python scripts/build.py --check`.
